headline: Australia headline inflation accelerates to 4.3% amid cost-of-living crisis
summary: Australia's annual inflation rate rose to 4.3%, heightening market expectations for a fifth interest rate hike by the central bank this year.
why: Persistent inflation prints force central banks to maintain or tighten monetary policy, elevating borrowing costs for businesses and mortgage holders.

impacts.name: Australian Dollar
impacts.why: Higher-than-expected inflation increases the likelihood of interest rate hikes, boosting currency yields.

why_moved: An unexpected acceleration in consumer price inflation fueled market bets on further monetary policy tightening by the Reserve Bank of Australia.
